items.title: Hey, everyone! We’re working on a 12-hole version of the Trochilus.
items.excerpt: Hey, everyone! We’re working on a 12-hole version of the Trochilus. Now down to two tuning options: • Standard Richter — for blues. • A Richter version with Low A and Low Low A (LLA) with the slide in — giving more low-register range for folk and pop. Which one would you pick? A…

items.title: House Of The Rising Sun 🎶
items.excerpt: House Of The Rising Sun 🎶 One of the most haunting traditional folk‑blues ballads. No lyrics today, just harmonica carrying its sad, timeless story from New Orleans. This old song has traveled across decades, telling a tale of loss and regret.

items.title: SPAH 2026 wrapped up last week.
items.excerpt: SPAH 2026 wrapped up last week. It was great spending the week in St. Louis, seeing familiar faces, meeting new players, and talking harmonicas face to face. A big thank-you to everyone who stopped by and spent some time with JDR. See you next time! Rodrigo Eberienos Ross Garren
